serverpassword.gui.button.tooltip: Set the password sent when joining a server
serverpassword.gui.entry.title: Server Password
serverpassword.gui.entry.explain.what: On a server without licence checks anyone can take your name. This password claims it for you.
serverpassword.gui.entry.explain.first: Your first login registers this password for your name; after that it is required.
serverpassword.gui.entry.explain.change: Only an operator can change or reset it later, so pick one you will remember.
serverpassword.disconnect.registration_c: This name is not registered and new registrations are closed.
serverpassword.disconnect.password_reset: An operator reset your password. Set a new one and rejoin.
serverpassword.disconnect.retry: That name was just registered by someone else. Please try again.
serverpassword.disconnect.not_ready: The server is not ready to check passwords yet.
serverpassword.disconnect.storage_broken: The server's password file is unreadable. Ask an operator to fix it.
serverpassword.disconnect.client_no_pass: No password set. Set one with the Password button on the Multiplayer screen.
This server needs a password. Set one with the Password button on the Multiplayer screen; your first login registers it.
serverpassword.disconnect.client_error: Failed to compute the password proof.
serverpassword.command.unavailable: The password store is not loaded.
serverpassword.command.reset.success: Cleared the password for '%s'. Their next login registers a new one.
serverpassword.command.list.empty: No players have registered a password yet.
